content: This ruling addressed the division of a vast real estate portfolio following a separation. The parties reached a settlement based on a technical expert's report, but one specific property presented a challenge due to irreparable building abuses,. The legal problem was whether such an "illegal" asset could be part of a judicial division. The judge applied the principle of non-transferability, deciding that the abusive property must be excluded from the division and remain in a state of ordinary communion, while the remaining lawful assets were divided according to the parties' agreement.
